catalog.name: ai-approval-flow

catalog.name: ai-response

No simulated typing delay on already-complete content

catalog.name: destructive-action
forbiddenRules: No tooltip or popover as the only warning surface

catalog.name: empty-state
catalog.intent: Explain why a region is empty and offer the way out.
forbiddenRules: No dead-end state with no explanation

catalog.name: form-submit
catalog.intent: Collect and validate input with accessible error reporting.
forbiddenRules: No placeholder used as the only label
No validation message shown only on hover
No submit button that silently no-ops while invalid
